chunks.title: Chinese passport tourism route for Nepal
chunks.content: For Chinese ordinary passport holders planning short tourism travel to Nepal, VIZA AI should consider the Nepal tourist visa on arrival or online pre-arrival route at authorized entry points. First confirm nationality, arrival airport or land border, stay length, accommodation, trek plans and whether restricted-area permits may be needed. Trekking and restricted-area permits are separate from the tourist visa. Keep advice limited to tourism/visitor travel unless the user states work, study, residence, immigration, journalism, volunteering or another regulated purpose.

chunks.title: Nepal on-arrival tourist visa process
chunks.content: Nepal Immigration states that Tourist Visa on Arrival is available at Tribhuvan International Airport and other authorized entry/exit points. Tourist visa on arrival is the only entry visa for tourists and is issued with multiple re-entry facility, with common 15-day, 30-day and 90-day categories. Chinese nationals are listed in Nepal guidance as eligible for on-arrival visa at authorized entry points.

chunks.title: Nepal documents and trekking caution
chunks.content: For Nepal, collect passport validity, arrival airport/land border, intended stay length, photo, accommodation/itinerary and whether the user will trek or enter restricted areas. Explain that trekking permits or restricted-area permits are separate from the tourist visa and may be needed for certain routes.

chunks.title: Standard passport identity-field answer rules
chunks.content: Standard-answer identity fields must be answered from the applicant's passport biodata page, official identity document, MRZ where that field is encoded, or the official form's dropdown options. This applies to passport number, name, date of birth, sex, nationality, issuing country, issue date, expiry date, issuing authority, place of issue, and passport/document type. Treat issuing country, place of issue, and issuing authority as distinct fields and never substitute one for another. Place of issue / 签发地点 asks for the location recorded on the passport or required by the official form, such as a city, province, municipality, or a country selected from an official country-only dropdown; copy the passport's Place of issue value when present, and enter a country only when the form explicitly asks for Country of issue / Issuing country or provides a country-only selector. Issuing authority / 签发机关 asks for the organization printed under Authority / Issuing authority. For Chinese ordinary passports, National Immigration Administration, PRC / 中华人民共和国国家移民管理局 and MPS Exit & Entry Administration / 公安部出入境管理局 are issuing-authority examples only and must never be suggested as place-of-issue answers. Do not infer either field from the pickup city, residence city, application country, or travel destination. If the passport prints a different value for the requested field, use that exact field value. For passport type, select Ordinary / Regular / Normal only for ordinary personal passports; select Diplomatic, Official, Service, Special, Travel document, Refugee, or Other only when the document explicitly indicates that type. Official sources reviewed for this standard field rule include China National Immigration Administration certificate-issuing-authority notices and the Passport Law of the People's Republic of China; the passport biodata page and the destination's official field wording remain the final sources for the applicant's individual answer.
